answers.evidence:
Verified three ways: Node 22 probe (pure JS semantics), a real Go program against the **goja** ES engine (same mechanics as a QuickJS binding — the runtime drains its microtask job queue when the top-level script returns, so the IIFE promise is already settled), and `go test`:

```
$ go run .
BROKEN  x = {}                        ← JSON.stringify(promise) — value swallowed
FIXED   x = {"v":42}
FIXED   y = {"saw":{"v":42}}          ← promise probe from problem statement
EDGE    sync fn through wrap = {"n":6}
EDGE    rejection propagates: node fn rejected: Error: boom
EDGE    thenable = {"t":1}

$ go test -v ./...
--- PASS: TestRawJSWrapExact       (exact wrap string)
--- PASS: TestRawJSWrapComponents  (structural invariants)
--- PASS: TestEvalNodePromiseProbe (x={"v":42}, y={"saw":{"v":42}})
```

Edge cases tested:

| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| Promise probe `x={v:42}, y={saw:{v:42}}` | `{"v":42}` → `{"saw":{"v":42}}` ✓ |
| 3-node async chain x→y→z | z = `{"deep":{"saw":{"v":42}}}` ✓ |
| Sync fn through wrap (`await` on non-promise is a no-op) | `{"n":6}` ✓ (backward compatible) |
| Named `async function f(prev){...}` source | `{"n":2}` ✓ (double-paren grouping) |
| First node, no input (prev null/empty) | `{"seed":true}` ✓ |
| Rejection `async () => { throw }` | propagated as error — no longer swallowed ✓ |
| Custom thenable `{then: res => res({t:1})}` | `{"t":1}` ✓ (await flattens) |
| Promise-of-promise | `{"deep":1}` ✓ (await flattens) |
| `undefined` completion | `JSON.stringify(undefined)` → `undefined` (pre-existing engine semantic, unchanged by wrap) |
| String completion | double-encoded `"hi"` (pre-existing stringify semantic, same as sync fns) |

Exact wrap emitted: `(async () => JSON.stringify(await ((FN))(PREV)))()` — matches the required RawJS shape byte-for-byte.
